evals.name: legacy-record-separation
evals.prompt: Backfill my old completed papers and idea files so the taste model has more training data.
evals.expected_output: A staged inventory that separates confirmed human history from inferred legacy candidates and asks for confirmation before any inferred item receives human weight.
expectations: The workflow never fabricates ratings, pairwise preferences, read depth, or human decisions from file existence.
Inferred backfill signals have zero taste-training weight until confirmed.
Existing personal files are backed up and updated through a single writer only after approval.
